label: Minute-by-Minute Monitoring
definition: Continuous monitoring of physiological parameters at one-minute intervals to capture real-time data.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Data that measures the results of treatment and management approaches in patients with brain injury.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A clinical condition resulting from trauma to the brain, which is the focus of monitoring and treatment in intensive care units.

label: Sensor Accuracy
definition: The degree to which a sensor's recorded value reflects the true value, mentioned in the context of evaluating data errors.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: Arterial oxygen saturation measured by pulse oximetry, indicating blood oxygenation levels.

label: Neurological Injury
definition: A clinical condition involving damage to the nervous system, which may affect cognitive and physical functions.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: Transcranial Doppler ultrasonography, used to assess cerebral blood flow velocity.

label: Clinical Research Form (CRF)
definition: A document used to collect data on adverse events in clinical trials, requiring careful design to capture relevant information.

label: Management
definition: The clinical approach to treating and monitoring patients with brain injury in intensive care settings.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: Partial pressure of brain tissue oxygen, measuring local cerebral oxygenation.

label: Substance Abuse
definition: A clinical condition characterized by the harmful use of psychoactive substances, which may complicate medical treatment.

label: Suctioning
definition: A nursing intervention involving the removal of secretions from the airway to maintain patency.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: A physiological parameter measuring pressure in the thoracic vena cava near the right atrium, used in critical care monitoring.

label: Head Injury
definition: An injury to the skull or brain that can result in serious health consequences and is a leading cause of death in young males.

label: Machine
definition: A device used in medical evaluations that incorporates sensors for data collection.

label: Acceptable Range
definition: The defined limits within which recorded values should fall, mentioned in the context of data evaluation.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: End-tidal carbon dioxide concentration, reflecting ventilation adequacy.

label: Icu Medical Data
definition: Data collected from patients in an Intensive Care Unit, specifically mentioned in the context of monitoring and evaluation.

label: Uri
definition: A Uniform Resource Identifier used to uniquely identify resources on the web, facilitating data linking and access.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded value from a parameter being observed in patient data.

label: Provenance
definition: Information regarding the origin and history of data, which is crucial for assessing its quality and trustworthiness.
